name: Chiapas
about: San Cristóbal sits at 2,200m and stays genuinely cool — even cold at night — a sharp contrast to Palenque's hot, humid jungle. Dry season (Nov–Apr) is best for touring both; rainy season (May–Oct) makes Sumidero Canyon and the waterfalls more dramatic but the roads slower.
overview: San Cristóbal de las Casas's colonial streets and highland Maya culture, paired with Palenque's jungle-swallowed ruins a few hours away.
costOverview: Chiapas is one of Mexico's most affordable regions to visit — a real local meal costs just a few dollars, and even the marquee Sumidero Canyon boat tour stays budget-friendly.
